activity_statements.statement: operates PlayStation gaming platform and network, including PS5 hardware, first-party game titles, and PlayStation Network subscription services for 129 million monthly active accounts
operates Sony Music Entertainment (recorded music labels) and Sony Music Publishing (catalog rights), with streaming revenues growing 5% (recorded) and 13% (publishing) in FY2024
produces and distributes films and TV content through Sony Pictures, including franchises based on Spider-Man, Jumanji, and Venom IPs, and licenses IP to location-based entertainment
streams anime content globally through Crunchyroll (15M+ paid subscribers) as a direct-to-consumer anime platform
manufactures and sells consumer electronics including cameras (Alpha mirrorless), audio products (headphones, speakers), and televisions through the Entertainment, Technology & Services segment
manufactures CMOS image sensors for smartphones and other devices through Sony Semiconductor Solutions, supplying the global mobile imaging ecosystem
is forming a joint venture with TSMC for advanced semiconductor manufacturing through Sony Semiconductor Solutions
generates over 60% of consolidated sales from its three entertainment businesses (Game & Network Services, Music, Pictures) as of FY2024

name_reality_gap: Index label 'Entertainment Providers' captures the direction but misses that Sony is equally a semiconductor company (world-leading CMOS image sensor supplier to smartphones), a consumer electronics manufacturer, and a financial services business — the label invites the assumption of a pure media/content company.
extraction_notes: sony.com/CorporateInfo was sparse; strong data obtained from Sony Corporate Report 2025 PDF via Exa search and Sony IR page. Segment revenue weights are approximate based on report context; exact FY2024 segment revenue percentages not extracted from the PDF. Financial Services partial spin-off scheduled Oct 2025.
